deskyard browser connect: forward the desktop's browser to a local CDP port

Usage: deskyard [-d NAME] browser connect [--port N]

Listens on 127.0.0.1:PORT and forwards the Chrome DevTools Protocol to the
desktop's shared Chromium (the one on its desktop, with the human's logins),
so Playwright, Puppeteer or DevTools tools connect as if the browser were
local. Prints the URL, then keeps running until Ctrl-C. Run it in the
background. Inside a desktop it isn't needed: CDP is at http://127.0.0.1:9221.

Options:
  --port N             local port (0 = any free port) (default 9222)

Prints: first line: the local CDP URL (http://127.0.0.1:9222); connection log
  on stderr

Examples:
  deskyard -d alice browser connect &
  # then in Python: p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9222")

Where: on the chosen remote (-d NAME); inside a desktop without a remote it acts locally
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
